rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha on 27 December 1990, under 'Introduction of Ministers', the Prime Minister, Shri Chandra Shekhar ('THE PRIME MINISTER (SHRI CHANDRA SHEKHAR)'), introduces nine Ministers, Ministers of State and Deputy Ministers to the House.
